output_list.criticism: This code vulnerability is triggered because the current code is always minting tokens to the address passed as an argument to the mint function. Minting a token to the address with no condition could lead to: 1) Token can never be used and just resides in contract indefinitely 2) Token could be used for malicious purposes like giving wrong user the token, which could lead to loss 3) Token can be claimed for free. This problem is considered as high severity, high profitability and 100% correctness rate
